subjects.review: Project through perspective or orthographic HSD camera; unsupported modes return NULL; near-depth adjustment precedes GXProject.

facts.value: Consumes the source Vec3 and the camera's projection type, perspective or orthographic parameters, near/far planes, viewport bounds, and viewing state. It converts the projection matrix into GXProject's seven-value compact projection array and the camera viewport into a six-value origin/size/depth array. Depending on `d`, the model-view matrix either comes from eye/up/interest vectors passed through C_MTXLookAt or directly from HSD_CObjGetViewingMtxPtr. The source position is copied, conditionally shifted along the viewing matrix's third row to camera-space z = -0.01, then passed with those arrays to GXProject, which writes x, y, and z into `screenCoords`.
